storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP GoHighLevel Downloader makes it easy to save videos from GoHighLevel membership areas, course pages, and client portals.

How it works: Navigate to any lesson or page in your GoHighLevel portal, play the video, and click the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension automatically detects the GoHighLevel environment and identifies the video source -- whether it is a native GoHighLevel HLS stream or an embedded Loom, Vimeo, Wistia, or YouTube player. It shows available quality options and downloads the video as a standard MP4 file.

It handles GoHighLevel native HLS streams, Loom recordings, Vimeo embeds, Wistia players, and YouTube videos automatically -- no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required.

Key features:
- Automatic GoHighLevel portal and membership area detection
- GoHighLevel native HLS video support with automatic MP4 conversion
- Multi-platform support: Loom, Vimeo, Wistia, YouTube embeds
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Concurrent download support (up to 3 simultaneous downloads)
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- Dark-themed UI with sky blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to your GoHighLevel portal and play a video
3. Click the extension icon
4. Select quality and download -- saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: What GoHighLevel pages does this work with?
faq.answer: Any GoHighLevel-powered portal, membership area, or course page. The extension detects the GoHighLevel environment automatically using DOM markers like x-cp-build-version and clientportal-siteCustomHeader, as well as GoHighLevel/HighLevel hostname patterns.

faq.question: What video platforms are supported?
faq.answer: GoHighLevel native HLS video, Loom, Vimeo, Wistia, and YouTube embeds. Each platform has a dedicated detector and handler for reliable extraction.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Go to any lesson or page in your GoHighLevel portal and press play on the video. Then click the extension icon in your toolbar.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from the embedded platform or the GoHighLevel HLS manifest. Options depend on what the video host provides -- typically multiple resolutions up to 1080p or higher.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player. GoHighLevel native HLS streams are automatically converted to MP4 during download.

faq.question: Can I download multiple videos at once?
faq.answer: Yes -- the extension supports up to 3 concurrent downloads with individual progress tracking.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Skool, Circle, or Kajabi?
faq.answer: No -- Skool, Circle, and Kajabi each have their own dedicated SERP downloader extensions. This extension is specifically for GoHighLevel portals.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes -- supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Make sure you are on a GoHighLevel portal page. Press play on the video first. The extension needs the stream to start before detection works. If issues persist, refresh the page.

faq.question: Does this handle GoHighLevel native video (not just embeds)?
faq.answer: Yes. GoHighLevel uses HLS streaming for its native video player (Plyr). The extension discovers the m3u8 manifest, fetches all segments, and stitches them into a downloadable MP4 file.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP -- no passwords stored.
